name: developer/dependency-upgrade
title: Dependency Upgrade
description: Safely perform a bounded upgrade of ONE dependency. Establishes the current version, finds the usage that could break, applies the update through the project's own package manager, verifies, and reports remaining compatibility concerns. Deliberately scoped to the named package — it never sweeps the whole dependency tree.

target_version.description: Target version; omit to move to the latest the manager resolves

update_command.description: The exact package-manager command that performs the bounded update (e.g. 'npm install lodash@4.17.21'). Supplied explicitly so the workflow never invents a mutation.

steps.name: usage
steps.title: Find usage that an upgrade could break

steps.name: pre_state
steps.title: Record the working tree before the update

steps.name: update
steps.title: Apply the bounded update through the package manager

steps.name: change
steps.title: Confirm only the intended manifests changed

steps.name: verify
steps.title: Verify the project against the new version

result.compatibility_note: usage_sites lists every reference to the package that an upgrade could affect. dependency_changes shows what actually moved; anything outside the dependency manifests means the update was wider than requested.
